A little help

Use the navigation to log bodyweight, food, or lifts. Edit an entry to correct it, or choose Delete and then Undo delete to restore it. Repeat copies an entry into today’s form for you to review and save. Your journal is saved to your account on this server. Export downloads a JSON backup of all entries.
